title: Murder of Jessica Lal
narrative: FIR — 30 April 1999, Qutab Colonnade restaurant, Mehrauli, New Delhi. Jessica Lal, a 34-year-old model working as a celebrity barmaid, was shot dead with a .22 calibre pistol by Manu Sharma (Siddharth Vashisht), son of a politician, after she refused to serve him a drink. Witnesses included Shayan Munshi and Bina Ramani. The Delhi Police investigated. Manu Sharma was acquitted in 2006 by the trial court, then convicted by the Delhi High Court and sentenced to life imprisonment, upheld by the Supreme Court in 2010.
